_doc: IDEA-BANK-1 (Rowan, 2026-11-22: the front-door examples must be diverse and actually buildable). Every idea the front door suggests lives here with its domain, reach and the four system-test answers. scripts/build_idea_bank.py runs each one through the seed's own bootstrap stages (read, qualify, instrument) on a generated IDEA.md, refuses the bank when one fails or when the domains are not diverse, and writes site/idea-bank-data.js, which site/suggest.js and site/interview.js read. DEPTH-1 (Rowan, 2026-11-22: 'the depth of idea, the depth of concept of Unlearn and Practical Solutions'): every idea also names its depth: the corpus it keeps growing, the method that makes it trustworthy, and why a reader comes back. A one-trick idea (a single feed, a single alert) has no corpus and is refused. Edit this file, never the generated one. PUBLIC-GOOD-1 (Rowan, 2026-11-22: 'This is about some kind of bigger good, some kind of public good, something that empowers change ... Go get Squarespace if you want e-commerce'): every idea names the change it empowers (`empowers`); domains in `refused_domains` (selling, shops, orders, cost cutting) are refused. WORLDWIDE-1 (Rowan, 2026-11-22: 'these ideas have to work worldwide ... if you don't have the data to back them up, they're not going to work ... point and click and get running'): every idea lists `data`, the worldwide open sources it runs on (or `own`, the user's own records, which exist anywhere); a source with a probe URL is fetched by `build_idea_bank.py --live` (weekly in scout.yml) and an idea whose sources stop answering is retired. GROW-1: `build_idea_bank.py --grow` asks the model route for a new idea each pass, admits it only through the same gates, and retires the oldest beyond `max_active`, so the set never goes static.

ideas.text: A living atlas of what works in public policy: every programme graded by its trials and re-graded as evidence lands
ideas.keywords: policy government programme evidence trials what works social public research
ideas.loop: new trials and reviews found weekly, each programme's grade revised, readers' questions turned into new entries
ideas.measure: programmes whose evidence was checked in the last 30 days, target all
ideas.upkeep: trials publish every week and programmes are renamed, scaled up or cut

depth.corpus: hundreds of programmes across housing, health, justice and education, each with its trials
depth.method: grades by study design, shown honestly, with where the evidence is thin
depth.returns: grades move as evidence lands, so a policy reader checks before each decision

ideas.empowers: lets voters, staff and journalists hold programmes to what the evidence shows

ideas.text: A regional food-system map: farms, food banks, prices and gaps, used every week to route surplus to where it is short
ideas.keywords: food bank farms surplus hunger prices region supply charity community
ideas.loop: listings and prices refreshed weekly, gaps computed, surplus offers matched to shortfalls and the match followed up
ideas.measure: surplus offered that reached a food bank within 48 hours
ideas.upkeep: farms, prices and needs change every week

depth.corpus: every farm, food bank and pantry in a region with stock, hours and needs
depth.method: each listing confirmed at its source on a schedule; unconfirmed rows are marked
depth.returns: new surplus and new shortfalls every week

ideas.empowers: gets surplus food to people who are short of it

ideas.text: A claim tracker that follows viral claims, links each to its evidence and updates the verdict when evidence moves
ideas.keywords: misinformation fact check claims news viral evidence media truth
ideas.loop: new claims picked up daily, matched to existing entries or opened, verdicts revised when new evidence appears
ideas.measure: verdicts revised within 7 days of new evidence
ideas.upkeep: new claims appear every day and old ones resurface

depth.corpus: a growing graph of claims, their variants and the evidence on each
depth.method: verdicts graded by evidence strength, with what would change them
depth.returns: the same claims come back in new forms, and the record follows them

ideas.empowers: lets anyone check a claim before passing it on

data.name: Google Fact Check Tools (ClaimReview, worldwide fact-checkers)

ideas.text: An atlas of climate adaptation: which flood, heat and drought measures worked where, graded by what happened after
ideas.keywords: climate adaptation flood heat drought resilience city environment evidence
ideas.loop: case studies and evaluations gathered monthly, each measure re-graded, cities' questions answered from the atlas
ideas.measure: measures with an outcome evaluation attached
ideas.upkeep: new projects and evaluations every month

depth.corpus: measures from cities worldwide with their costs and measured results
depth.method: results graded by evaluation design; untested claims are marked as such

ideas.empowers: helps towns spend scarce money on measures that protect people

ideas.text: A replication ledger for a field: which landmark findings held up and which failed, updated as replications publish
ideas.keywords: research replication science psychology findings papers evidence academic
ideas.loop: new replications found weekly, each finding's standing updated, citing papers flagged when a finding falls
ideas.measure: findings whose standing was checked in the last 30 days
ideas.upkeep: replications and reanalyses publish every week

depth.corpus: the field's landmark findings, each with every replication attempt
depth.method: standing set by replication size and quality, with the reasoning shown
depth.returns: textbooks and talks keep citing findings whose standing has moved

ideas.empowers: stops shaky findings from steering policy and teaching

ideas.text: A model evaluation harness that re-tests every new AI model release against its own history
ideas.keywords: model evaluation benchmark regression ai release llm
ideas.loop: each release run through the same tests, scores compared with history, regressions filed
ideas.measure: regressions found before a release is adopted
ideas.upkeep: models and providers release new versions every month

depth.corpus: a growing suite of tests and every score every model has had
depth.method: fixed tests, repeated runs and published variance
depth.returns: every new release is a new comparison

ideas.empowers: gives the public an independent record of how AI models really behave

ideas.text: A free open curriculum that rewrites each lesson from where learners actually get stuck
ideas.keywords: curriculum education learning lessons school students teachers course open
ideas.loop: learner answers read after each unit, the lesson with the most stuck points rewritten, the change measured on the next cohort
ideas.measure: share of learners who pass each unit's check, target rising per cohort
ideas.upkeep: every cohort shows new stuck points

depth.corpus: a full course of lessons, exercises and the record of where people stumbled
depth.method: each rewrite is an experiment kept only if the next cohort does better
depth.returns: learners move unit by unit, and teachers reuse it every term

ideas.empowers: gives any learner a free course that keeps getting better

ideas.text: A website for our club or association that learns what brings members back and grows the features they use
ideas.keywords: club association website members community society group sports events
ideas.loop: visits, sign-ups and event turnout read weekly, the feature or page members use least improved, turnout read again
ideas.measure: members who return each month and event turnout
ideas.upkeep: events, members and season plans change all year

depth.corpus: years of events, members' turnout and what each change to the site did
depth.method: each change is predicted and kept only if return visits or turnout rose
depth.returns: members come back for every event, and the club's record keeps growing

ideas.empowers: keeps volunteer-run community groups alive and growing

data.name: own
data.note: the club's own first-party, cookieless site analytics

ideas.text: An impact ledger for a charity that links every programme to its outcomes and shows funders what each donation changed
ideas.keywords: charity nonprofit impact outcomes funders donors programme evaluation
ideas.loop: programme data read monthly, outcomes recomputed, the weakest programme flagged with what similar charities do
ideas.measure: programmes with a measured outcome, target all
ideas.upkeep: programmes, people served and funders change every year

depth.corpus: every programme, its spend and the outcomes it produced over the years
depth.method: outcomes compared with a baseline, uncertainty stated
depth.returns: each reporting cycle and funding round draws on it

ideas.empowers: moves donations toward what actually helps people

ideas.text: A funding atlas for small charities: every open call, how well it fits and a drafted answer, kept current
ideas.keywords: grants funding proposals deadlines nonprofit fundraiser charity
ideas.loop: funder pages read weekly, matching calls filed with a draft, outcomes recorded to sharpen the fit score
ideas.measure: matching calls missed before their deadline, target 0
ideas.upkeep: funders open and close calls all year

depth.corpus: every funder and call, with past awards and what won
depth.method: fit scored from past awards; drafts reuse answers that succeeded

ideas.empowers: gets funding to small charities that cannot afford a fundraiser

ideas.text: A decision journal that records each big choice, its reasons and how it turned out, and learns what I misjudge
ideas.keywords: decisions journal personal reflection choices life habits memory
ideas.loop: each decision logged with a prediction, revisited when it resolves, my blind spots summarised quarterly
ideas.measure: share of predictions that came true, per quarter

depth.corpus: years of my own decisions, predictions and outcomes
depth.method: every decision carries a prediction that is scored later
depth.returns: every new choice is checked against my own track record

ideas.empowers: helps a person learn from their own choices instead of repeating mistakes

data.name: own
data.note: the person's own decisions and predictions

ideas.text: A personal experiments log that turns my habits into small tests and keeps only what measurably helps
ideas.keywords: habits sleep fitness personal experiments health log routine
ideas.loop: one change tried for two weeks, the measure compared with the baseline, kept or dropped, the next test chosen
ideas.measure: experiments that measurably helped, per quarter

depth.corpus: every habit I have tried, with its before-and-after numbers
depth.method: baseline, one change at a time, a fixed test window
depth.returns: there is always a next test

ideas.empowers: helps a person find what really improves their life, by evidence instead of hype

data.name: own
data.note: the person's own habit and health measurements

ideas.text: A living history of a city told from its archives, adding sources and correcting the record as documents surface
ideas.keywords: history city archives local heritage stories writing creative museum
ideas.loop: archives searched monthly, new sources attached, stories revised where a document changes the account
ideas.measure: claims in each story tied to a cited source, target all
ideas.upkeep: archives digitise new material every month

depth.corpus: a growing set of stories, places and people, each tied to sources
depth.method: every claim cites its document; disputed points show both sides
depth.returns: new stories and corrections arrive every month

ideas.empowers: gives a community an accurate, shared record of its own past

ideas.text: An open-source dependency watch that maps who relies on what, flags risky packages and proposes fixes upstream
ideas.keywords: open source dependencies packages security maintainers supply chain software
ideas.loop: the dependency graph rebuilt weekly, risks scored, fixes proposed to the projects that can make them
ideas.measure: high-risk dependencies with a proposed fix
ideas.upkeep: new releases and new risks every day

depth.corpus: a map of packages, maintainers and the projects that depend on them
depth.method: risk scored from maintenance, security history and reach
depth.returns: the graph changes with every release

ideas.empowers: protects the open-source commons that public services run on

ideas.text: A public-contracts watch that follows government tenders and awards and flags the ones that look rigged
ideas.keywords: government contracts procurement tenders corruption spending accountability civic
ideas.loop: new tenders and awards read daily, red flags scored, flagged contracts followed to delivery and the flags re-scored
ideas.measure: flagged contracts later confirmed as problems, against false flags
ideas.upkeep: governments publish new tenders every day

depth.corpus: every published tender, bidder and award in the jurisdictions with open data
depth.method: red flags from published procurement-risk indicators, each shown with its evidence
depth.returns: new contracts every day and a growing record of who won what

ideas.empowers: lets citizens and journalists see where public money goes and who gets it
